formulas.notation: C net ETH collateral valued in hypothetical USD; L leverage; N=L*C; f=.023; i adverse per-leg factor; r CLAUS/ETH price ratio; a upfront rate on N; g each transaction gas; k liquidation reward
formulas.long: D=(L-1)C; Q=N(1-f)/(p0(1+i)); V=N(1-f)^2*r/(1+i)^2; E=max(0,V-D-g-k); loss=max(0,D-max(0,V-g-k)); pnl=E-C-aN-g
formulas.short: Q=N/p0; S=N(1-f)/(1+i); B=N*r*(1+i)/(1-f); E=max(0,C+S-B-g-k); token repayment=Q*min(1,max(0,C+S-g-k)/B); token loss=Q-repayment; pnl=E-C-aN-g
formulas.inventory: ETH inventory >= nLong*(L-1)C/u; CLAUS inventory >= nShort*L*C/(p0*u); separate first-loss reserve=10% outstanding loan entry value; gas reserve=n*(2g+k)
formulas.capacity: actual cap=min(inventory*utilization, executable-depth budget, independently measured manipulation-loss budget); provisional actual cap=0. Hypothetical CP buy average impact=(1-f)G/R, hence G<=epsilon R/(1-f); aggregate same-side liquidation size must obey stress executable-depth budget
formulas.provider_net: upfront receipts - bad debt in loan asset - gas/service costs paid by provider; model net uses entry-price loss and $1 service, trader-funded gas, no allocations diverted; entry-value short P&L is not realized ETH profit
formulas.rounding: contract debt up, user payout down to 18 decimal units; model float calculations illustrative, directed Decimal rounding self-check only
formulas.provider_fee_segregation: project_fee=total_fee*20/23; platform_fee=total_fee*3/23; neither is provider revenue

stress_interpretation.price_stresses: instant forced exit at endpoint, not simulated timely liquidation; $100 collateral, keeper $2 and gas $4.05
stress_interpretation.keeper_outages: 1/5/30 minutes use illustrative +/-1% per-minute path; elapsed time itself does not imply price change; one-block -90% or +1000% may precede any keeper
stress_interpretation.thin_liquidity: no executable exit implies up to 100% lent principal loss; reserve can also be exhausted
stress_interpretation.true_worst_case: all allocated lending and reserve capital can be lost; CLAUS liability mark in ETH can grow without bound though tokens lent are finite
stress_interpretation.expense_waterfall: Pessimistic position cash pays closing gas/reward before loan debt. Separate escrow is not credited to loan recovery; paying expenses from escrow instead lowers loan shortfall but consumes that reserved capital.
